notes.title: October update of MAZE
notes.notes:
Four new maps have been added to this update of MAZE. At the same time, new gate and box have been added. Maze will continue to bring more stylized maps to players. Please look forward to the next update.

notes.title: EA-1.0.2 Update - Add Quick Play
notes.notes:
This update added Quick Play Function to the game. You can play all the published contents of [i][b]MAZE[/b][/i] without any unlocking or upgrading.
At the same time, new mazes and puzzles are being produced, please look forward to it!

notes.title: MAZE is now on sale
notes.notes:
[i]MAZE [/i]has been released on Steam. From now on, the game has entered Early-Access, Free content updates will be provided regularly. I hope you can join me in making [i]MAZE [/i]into a better maze exploration game.
If you find any bugs while playing, or want to make any suggestions, or even want to provide ideas, you can leave messages in the community. I will confirm messages regularly and reply on it. I will fix the known bugs as soon as possible, optimize the game, and actively accept excellent player ideas. With your help, [i]MAZE [/i]can grow up.
The next content update will bring 4 new mazes and new challenges to you. The updates are expected to arrive in October. Please look forward it!
Thanks for playing my game!

notes.title: In Final Testing
notes.notes:
[i]MAZE [/i]has now completed all functions and entered the final testing.
The game will be launched as soon as the test is completed.
During this period, I will introduce in detail the contents of the game  in stages. Please look forward to it!
